name: Grits
siboNotes: Plain grits are well-tolerated for SIBO as they contain minimal fermentable carbohydrates and are easily digestible.
preparationTips: Cook with lactose-free milk or water instead of regular milk
Avoid adding high-FODMAP ingredients like onion or garlic powder
Use low-FODMAP seasonings like chives, herbs, or a small amount of aged cheese
Stone-ground grits may be more nutritious but take longer to cook
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of iron and B vitamins
Provides complex carbohydrates for sustained energy
